audit.whatIsWrong: Two ability descriptions were wrong. The page calls Fate Sealed a knockup in four places, and it describes Spirit Cleave as an 'empowered third hit'.
audit.why: Riot's text: Fate Sealed 'blinks behind the last champion in a line with a slash so powerful it pulls all enemies hit towards him' - a blink and a pull, with no knockup flag. Spirit Cleave is a cone on a flat 14-second cooldown that shields him more for each champion hit; there is no third-hit mechanic. The knockup in his kit belongs to Mortal Steel at two stacks.
audit.corrected: Fate Sealed blinks behind you and pulls; Spirit Cleave is a 14s cone shield; Mortal Steel dashes and knocks up on its second stack.
sources: champ-data/_kits/yone.json (Q knockup+dash at 2 stacks, W shield 14s, R dash+pull)

audit.whatIsWrong: Soul Unbound was treated as an ever-present escape with no cooldown given.
audit.why: Soul Unbound falls 22/19/16/13/10s, so at rank 1 there is a 22-second window where he cannot rewind out of anything, and Feral Scream denies the cast on top. Fate Sealed is 120/100/80s and Spirit Cleave a flat 14s.
audit.corrected: Levels 3 through 6 are yours because Soul Unbound is still on 22 to 16 seconds; two items is his because it reaches 10.

audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Yone levels 2, 3, first item and two items and called 4-5 and 6 Skill stages, while the page's own text calls 3 through 6 'my window' and says the lane 'levels back toward even' only at first item.
audit.why: The chart and the prose disagreed at four stages. I aligned the chart to the prose, which also reads correctly against a 49.28% win rate over 483 games - a lane that is close, tips to Cho'Gath mid, and is lost late.

edits.before: Yone is genuinely even with me levels 1-3, and that is a fight I can hold. His Mortal Steel slashes and empowered Spirit Cleave chip me, but Carnivore tops me back up off every minion kill, so I never have to back from poke alone. The key rule: do not throw Rupture at a Yone who still has Soul Unbound up — he just rewinds out of the knockup and slow. Bait or wait out that E, then Q-into-W to silence him out of his own combo.
edits.after: Yone is genuinely even with me levels 1-3, and that is a fight I can hold. His Mortal Steel slashes and his Spirit Cleave cone chip me, but Carnivore tops me back up off every minion kill, so I never have to back from poke alone. The key rule: do not throw Rupture at a Yone who still has Soul Unbound up - he just rewinds out of the knockup and slow. Bait or wait out that E, which is 22 seconds at rank 1, then Q-into-W to silence him out of his own combo.

edits.before: This is where Yone takes the lane back, and I have to be honest about it. Past two items he is a mobile crit carry — Mortal Steel dashes in, Soul Unbound rewinds out, Fate Sealed knocks me up, and my telegraphed Rupture is too slow to pin him. My Feast stacks keep me alive in fights, but one-on-one he sidesteps my skillshots and out-DPSes my tankiness. So win the lane by 6, build my stack lead early, and play for teamfights where my Q knockup and W silence peel for my team rather than dueling him on a sidelane.
edits.after: This is where Yone takes the lane back, and I have to be honest about it. My Feast stacks keep me alive in fights, but one-on-one he sidesteps my skillshots and out-DPSes my tankiness. So win the lane by 6, build my stack lead early, and play for teamfights where my knockup and silence peel for my team.

notes: My level chart deviates from the packet chart at one stage: the packet marks Level 2 as Skill, but whys[1] on the page says he pokes with Mortal Steel and dashes out and that Cho'Gath cannot pin him without the full combo, which is a Yone stage. I followed the prose so the page is internally consistent - if the packet chart is authoritative, this one row should be flipped back to Skill. Of the packet's six suspectNames for this matchup, five ('Mortal Steel's', 'Fate Sealed's', 'Spirit Cleave's', 'His Mortal Steel', 'My Feast') are false positives on correct names in possessive or prefixed form; the real errors were the Fate Sealed knockup and the Spirit Cleave third hit, which the name checker could not see. Also: chogath.json tags Rupture with grounding, a tooltip-parse misfire on 'Ruptures the ground' (same on Malphite Q and Olaf Q), so I did not claim Rupture stops the Mortal Steel dash.
